exposure: distance between the niche and external os
Morphological parameters of the uterine niche (length, width, depth, volume, surface-area-to-volume ratio, distance from external os)
cohort: 205 women diagnosed with a symptomatic uterine niche by MRI
finding: The study found a positive correlation between the length of the uterine niche and the duration of post-menstrual spotting, while a greater distance between the niche and external os was associated with shorter spotting.
mod_finding: Women with two Caesarean sections had longer niche length diameters and more spherical niches compared to those with one Cesarean section, and also reported longer durations of post-menstrual spotting.
